## Final Problems

### What does this command line do?

```bash
man pwd
```
Displays the manual (man) for the print working directory (pwd). (Press Q to exit)

```bash
ls -lh
```
Lists the files and folders in the current location. It also shows details about them, including their sizes in an easy-to-read format.

```bash
mkdir -p /test1/test2/test3
```
Creates three folders, with test2 inside test1 and test3 inside test2. The -p option allows the computer to create any folders that do not already exist.

## Turkey transcripts

Locate the file called M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fa in the Unix/ DataFiles directory, which contains a few thousand coding sequences found in the genome of the wild turkey (Meleagris gallopavo). Use UNIX commands to perform the tasks below. Report the code you used.

### Copy the file to the sandbox

Copy the file to the Unix/sandbox directory.

```bash
mkdir -p ~/sandbox
cp ~/Downloads/M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fasta ~/sandbox/
```

### How big is the file?

```bash
ls -lh ~/sandbox/M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fasta
```
**Result:** 18M

### How many lines does it contain?

```bash
wc -l ~/sandbox/M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fasta
```
**Result:** 10782

### How many characters?

```bash
wc -m ~/sandbox/M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fasta
```
**Result:** 18569410

### What is the first line?

```bash
head -n 1 ~/sandbox/M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fasta
```
**Result:** >NM_001281869.1 Meleagris gallopavo trans-golgi network vesicle protein 23 homolog B (TVP23B), mRNA

### What are the last 3 lines?

```bash
tail -n 3 ~/sandbox/M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fasta
```

**Sequence text included in the original Week 1 document:**

```text

>XM_010719695.4 PREDICTED: Meleagris gallopavo radial spoke head 10 homolog B (RSPH10B), transcript variant X1, mRNA

```

### Rename the transcript file

```bash
mv ~/sandbox/M.gallopavo_GCF_905368555.1_transcripts.fasta ~/sandbox/Turkey_transcripts.fasta
```

## Clean up the sandbox

### Full path

```bash
realpath ~/sandbox
```
/Users/catherinebillups/sandbox

### Number of files

```bash
find ~/sandbox -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l
```
Result: 1

### Number of subdirectories

```bash
find ~/sandbox -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | wc -l
```
Result: 0

### Remove files and directories

```bash
ls -la ~/sandbox
find ~/sandbox -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf -- {} +
```

### Verify removal

```bash
ls -la ~/sandbox
```
